Notably the G block (36-39) merged with the c square (32-35) into one c object (32-39, 16-19) holding **two** cores — so the "G" block was a temporary gray state that became a charcoal c-block carrying the collected core.
Key learnings: horizontal step = 4 cols; head is a 1-col/1-row extension in facing direction; SPACE stretches 4 cells and absorbs c-square cores; un-stretch drops the stretched part as a c-block with the core inside.
Goal model: collect all cores (b) and deliver to the blue rectangle (28-31, 28-39). Two cores remain: one in c(32-39,16-19) pair, one in c(24-27,44-47).
Let me probe UP to check vertical movement.
